title: 荒城破晓

selectedMaster.selection: 人工首检：高处偏右仅一位半透明天使，双翼和单一号角清晰；完整旧城广场上恰好五人和一犬可逐一辨认，犬未被长衣遮住，石砖与六个地面角色的接触阴影连续。未做透明、细部或倾斜验收。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: 1024×1536 selected master artwork for a vertical Tarot v2 holographic-card project.
Input image: the immediately previous displayed Judgement tarot original is a composition/identity reference only.
Primary request: Create the theme “荒城破晓” (Dawn over the Ruined City), a finished vertical painterly fantasy Tarot master, no printed title or border. Exactly one semi-transparent celestial angel floats high in the upper-right, clearly visible with exactly two fully distinct wings and exactly one brass trumpet held to its mouth. The angel’s translucent dark blue inner robe and shadowed wing interiors must remain visibly painted, not washed out. On a broad intact old-city stone plaza across the lower half, exactly five human figures and exactly one clearly visible dog face toward dawn at the left-back horizon. The dog must not be hidden by any long garment. Preserve the full continuous load-bearing plaza stones and realistic contact shadows under all six ground figures; do not crop or turn this into thin ledges. The quiet old city buildings are complete and non-collapsed at both sides, with warm sunrise beyond the left-back street.
Scene/backdrop: silent sandstone-gray old city square, cool teal-blue shadows, distant warm-gold dawn.
Style/medium: highly detailed luminous painterly fantasy illustration, refined tarot art, soft atmospheric perspective.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, angel upper-right; dawn left-back; five people distributed as a readable group on the plaza lower half; dog visible in the foreground side; enough environmental continuity around every figure.
Lighting/mood: restrained hopeful dawn, warm-gold rays with cool blue shadow, no metallic skin.
Color palette: sandstone gray, warm gold, cyan-blue; natural skin colors.
Constraints: exactly one angel, two wings, one trumpet, five humans, one dog. Entire plaza ground and contact shadows retained. No extra people, no second dog, no second angel, no extra trumpet, no duplicate bodies, no cropped feet, no text, no lettering, no border, no watermark, no checkerboard.
generationRuns.conclusion: selected as master candidate; opaque RGB only, not a transparent layer or user-approved art

generationRuns.prompt: Run source/key_subject_green.py against source/subject-green-v01.png. It uses distance from #00FF00 for alpha and copies RGB from master-v01.png at the same coordinates.
generationRuns.conclusion: technical RGBA was produced, but its source was not a sufficiently uniform green matte: the script record says 98.32% nonzero alpha, while the later asset check reports only 30.92% fully transparent pixels and visual browser review shows keyed-edge defects. Not accepted as final foreground.
